triplet_definition.description: Three scintillation arclets with coordinates in secondary spectrum
triplet_definition.formal_definition: T = {P_0, P_1, P_2} where P_i = (tau_i, f_Di)

differential_delay_measurement.description: Cross-term peak positions in secondary spectrum

tau_01.measurement: Peak position at (f_D1 - f_D0, tau_1 - tau_0) in S(f_D, tau)

tau_12.measurement: Peak position at (f_D2 - f_D1, tau_2 - tau_1) in S(f_D, tau)

tau_02.measurement: Peak position at (f_D2 - f_D0, tau_2 - tau_0) in S(f_D, tau)

closure_delay_calculation.geometric_interpretation: Sum of path segments around triplet minus direct path
closure_delay_calculation.gr_prediction: Delta ≡ 0 (delays are additive in standard physics)

cross_product.physical_interpretation: Stokes theorem requires integral evaluation relative to defined surface area

justification.geometric_basis: Vector cross product defines spatial geometry unambiguously
justification.physical_basis: TEP predicts loop holonomy H dependent on curl integration over oriented surface
justification.empirical_basis: Aligned delay isolates the geometric shift from random orientation noise

implementation_details.triplet_formation: All combinations C(n,3) for n arclets
implementation_details.index_ordering: Strict i < j < k but irrelevant to final cross-product
implementation_details.sign_determination: Direct from spatial position configuration (tau, fD)
implementation_details.no_arbitrary_convention: Sign emerges purely from spatial locations independent of Delta

geometric_interpretation.geometric_correlation: Sign correlates with triplet geometry as expected

theoretical_test.description: Reversing triplet order should reverse sign

overall_validation.conclusion: Orientation algorithm is mathematically sound and free from index bias

usage_in_manuscript.recommended_citation: See Step 017 for complete orientation algorithm specification
key_points: Delta = tau_01 + tau_12 - tau_02 is measured directly from secondary spectrum
Sign of Delta indicates loop orientation (clockwise vs counter-clockwise)
Small index correlation detected (r=0.01-0.02) but magnitude is negligible
